description: This file contains controller reference management logic for Kubernetes, including classes and methods for claiming, adopting, and releasing controller ownership of objects like Pods, ReplicaSets, and ControllerRevisions.

classes.name: BaseControllerRefManager
classes.description: Manages controller references for generic objects, providing methods to claim ownership, check adoption permissions, and handle ownership logic.

classes.name: PodControllerRefManager
classes.description: Specialized manager for handling controller references of Pods, including claiming, adopting, and releasing ownership.

classes.name: ReplicaSetControllerRefManager
classes.description: Manager for handling controller references of ReplicaSets, including claiming, adopting, and releasing ownership.

classes.name: ControllerRevisionControllerRefManager
classes.description: Manager for handling controller references of ControllerRevisions, including claiming, adopting, and releasing ownership.

methods.name: CanAdopt
methods.description: Checks if the controller is allowed to adopt objects, caching the result.

methods.name: ClaimObject
methods.description: Attempts to claim ownership of an object, adopting or releasing as needed based on match criteria.

methods.name: AdoptPod
methods.description: Patches a Pod to set its owner reference to this controller.

methods.name: ReleasePod
methods.description: Removes the owner reference from a Pod to release ownership.

methods.name: ClaimPods
methods.description: Claims ownership of a list of Pods based on selector and filters.

methods.name: AdoptReplicaSet
methods.description: Patches a ReplicaSet to set its owner reference to this controller.

methods.name: ReleaseReplicaSet
methods.description: Removes the owner reference from a ReplicaSet.

methods.name: ClaimReplicaSets
methods.description: Claims ownership of a list of ReplicaSets.

methods.name: AdoptControllerRevision
methods.description: Sets owner reference for a ControllerRevision.

methods.name: ReleaseControllerRevision
methods.description: Removes owner reference from a ControllerRevision.

methods.name: AdoptControllerRevision
methods.description: Sets owner reference for a ControllerRevision.

methods.name: ReleaseControllerRevision
methods.description: Removes owner reference from a ControllerRevision.

methods.name: ownerRefControllerPatch
methods.description: Creates a JSON patch to add an owner reference to a controller.

methods.name: GenerateDeleteOwnerRefStrategicMergeBytes
methods.description: Creates a JSON patch to delete owner references from an object.

methods.name: ownerReference
methods.description: Helper to create owner reference patch data.
